parts.text: My company does not want management or analytical reports, exports, and dashboards beyond day-to-day operations, or logging in through our own corporate identity systems. We also do not want several languages, any guarantee of meeting regulations, compliance audits, or data-retention or deletion features. Furthermore, we do not want backups, high availability, spreading the service over several servers, accounts and passwords inside the service, or alerts to staff by e-mail, text message, or phone.
